name: std::istrstream::str
intro: Returns the pointer to the beginning of the buffer, after freezing it. Effectively calls rdbuf()->str().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the beginning of the buffer in the associated std::strstreambuf or a null pointer if no buffer is available.
